content:
The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are expected to keep the same screen sizes as the previous generation, but rumours suggest their displays will see improvements in two other areas. Here are the latest details.

#1: LTPO+ Technology

LTPO has long been the technology behind iPhone's Always-On Display and ProMotion screen features. There are rumours that Apple will switch to a more advanced LTPO+ technology in the iPhone 18 Pro.

The benefits of LTPO+ include reduced screen flickering in low-light environments (thanks to more responsive adjustments) and better power efficiency. As a result, iPhone 18 Pro users can expect a more stable display while consuming less power.

#2: Smaller Dynamic Island Cutout

The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are both expected to feature a smaller Dynamic Island cutout, slightly increasing the available screen space.

According to reports, the new Dynamic Island will be roughly 35% smaller than that of the iPhone 17 Pro. This size change may even be reflected in the new Siri design in iOS 27.

Apple first introduced the Dynamic Island on the iPhone 14 Pro back in 2022. While software features related to the Dynamic Island and Live Activities have steadily grown over time, the physical cutout has remained unchanged.

With the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, Apple is finally taking another step closer to the dream of a "zero-cutout" display.

What other changes would you like to see on future iPhone screens? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
